summary: Embed fairness, explainability, and accountability in AI products. Practise impact assessments, model cards, and oversight controls. Explore the course.
lede: Responsible AI product development embeds fairness, explainability, and accountability checks into AI product decisions. For AI/ML product managers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers, the training covers assessing impacts and bias, documenting models and datasets, and setting human review and escalation points. Practical exercises also address post-deployment monitoring and product reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for technical and product professionals who shape AI system requirements, evaluate model behaviour, document product decisions, or oversee deployment. It suits teams building or fine-tuning AI products in areas such as financial services, HR technology, healthcare, and public services.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with an AI/ML product lifecycle and basic model evaluation is expected. Coding is not required to complete the course; exercises use structured templates and spreadsheet-based analysis.
topics: Legal risk for AI, data and digital services
